title: Check: Plan Your Wireless and IoT

questions.prompt: Each SSID that separates a group (staff, guests, IoT) should map to its own VLAN and subnet.
In the worked example, which VLAN holds the IoT devices?
Why does the worked example add an LTE router?
options: As a backup internet link, for redundancy

questions.prompt: Which tool would you use to survey signal strength across your floor plan after installing? (one word)
The old printer only supports WPA2. Where does it go?
options: On the staff SSID, so staff can print
On the IoT segment, with WPA2 kept off the staff and guest networks

questions.prompt: A Zigbee hub's channel can be ignored when planning Wi-Fi channels.
Which is a good rule for IoT devices on arrival?
options: Leave the default password so the vendor can help
Give it access to every VLAN
Change the default password before it goes on the network

questions.prompt: What should you count when estimating usage: people or devices? (one word)
